species.name: Fox kit
species.blurb: Bold and curious; always has one ear turned to the next adventure.

species.name: Cloud-bird
species.blurb: Gentle and drifty; fluffs up when happy and naps anywhere soft.

species.name: Dragonling
species.blurb: Proud and playful; hoards shiny things and loves a fuss.

species.name: Mushroom pup
species.blurb: Loyal and clingy; follows you everywhere and loves damp, rainy days.

species.name: Forest sprite
species.blurb: Shy and quick; hums to plants and hides when startled.

species.name: River otter-spirit
species.blurb: Cheerful and restless; turns every moment into a game.

species.name: Star moth
species.blurb: Dreamy night-owl; glows brighter when it feels safe.

species.name: Pebble tortoise
species.blurb: Calm and stubborn; slow to start, impossible to rush.
